title: Rental advertising disclosure
summary: Requires landlords to disclose digitally altered photographs in rental advertisements.

title: Housing appropriations
summary: Funds affordable housing construction. No tax rates, credits, or exemptions are changed.

title: School medical staffing
summary: Requires public schools to employ nurses and funds medical care for students.

title: Residential energy efficiency
summary: Creates tax credits for installation of solar panels on residential buildings.

title: Pollution prevention
summary: Limits industrial wastewater discharges and protects river ecosystems.

title: Workplace rights
summary: Requires employers to provide paid family leave and protects employees against retaliation.

title: Electoral administration
summary: Changes voter registration deadlines and requires accessible voting locations.

title: Rail infrastructure
summary: Funds railway track improvements and expanded passenger train service.

title: Criminal sentencing
summary: Changes prison sentences for firearm offenses.

title: Food labeling
summary: Requires warning labels on foods containing specified ingredients to protect public health.

title: Commemorative designation
summary: Names an official state gemstone. No other provisions.
